concepts.idea: We start from what makes people hesitate (transport, guide, accommodation, meals) and show that the agency takes care of everything. The summit becomes the easy part.
why: Answers the real questions before they’re asked
The checklist shows everything that’s included

shots.description: Sunrise on the summit of Toubkal: a hiker with his arms raised, the group behind him, next to the tripod.
The phone: a “Toubkal — plan” note full of question marks.
A lone hiker by the road to Imlil. No transport.
The trail splits in three. Which way, without a guide?
Night falls in the mountains. Where to sleep?
A stove and an empty pot. What to eat?
The group climbs with the mule. The list ticks off in time with the voice: transport, guide, guesthouse, refuge, meals.
Close-up: boots moving along the trail.
The group at the summit. The counter climbs to 4,167 m.
End card: logo, “3 days · Friday → Sunday”, what’s included, WhatsApp button, Instagram account.

concepts.idea: The weekend told hour by hour, from leaving Marrakech to sunrise on the summit. People live the adventure before they book it.
why: Makes people dream with a sunrise at 4,167 m

shots.description: Friday. The van leaves Marrakech for the Atlas.
Arriving in Imlil at night, the guesthouse windows lit up.
Saturday. The group climbs the switchbacks. “6h” badge.
The refuge and the tents. “3,207 m” badge.
Sunday, 5 a.m. A line of headlamps climbs through the night.
8 a.m. The sun rises over the summit, the counter climbs to 4,167 m.
Sunday evening, at home: he scrolls through the weekend’s photos.
End card: “Départ kol weekend”, WhatsApp button, Instagram account. Departure dates are updated at delivery.
